<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReorderProduct" name="Product reorder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CourierRequest" name="Courier request"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductStock" name="Is selected product in stock?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForArrival" name="Wait for product arrival or 10 days"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrivalEarly" name="Product arrives within 10 days">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProductArrivalEarly" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_10DaysElapsed" name="10 days elapse without arrival">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_10Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P10D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty" messageRef="Message_DelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrivalLate" name="Product arrives after 10 days">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProductArrivalLate" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ArrivalMerge" name="Arrival path merge"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductPathMerge" name="Product handling path merge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Is the whole order ready for shipment?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShippingSplit" name="Request courier and pack products"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShippingJoin" name="Courier request and packing complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Products shipped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Gateway_ProductStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Withdraw" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductStock" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">selectedProductInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotStock_Reorder" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductStock" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not selectedProductInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_ProductMerge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductPathMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ArrivalEarly" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForArrival" targetRef="Event_ProductArrivalEarly"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Timer" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForArrival" targetRef="Event_10DaysElapsed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivalEarly_ArrivalMerge" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrivalEarly" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timer_Penalty" sourceRef="Event_10DaysElapsed" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_ArrivalLate" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Event_ProductArrivalLate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivalLate_ArrivalMerge" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrivalLate" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivalMerge_Register" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_ProductMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductPathMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductMerge_OrderReady" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductPathMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady_Shipping" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderReadyForShipment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderNotReady_NextProduct" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not orderReadyForShipment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextProduct_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingSplit_Courier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingSplit_Pack" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Courier_ShippingJoin" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pack_ShippingJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingJoin_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" name="Product reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ArrivalEarly" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Event_ProductArrivalEarly" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ArrivalLate" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Event_ProductArrivalLate" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Courier request" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
